NNB RECORDS Presents
Aaj Rang Hai — A Soulful Sufi Qawwali | Niazi Nizami Brothers
Dedicated to the spiritual and sacred atmosphere of the Dargah Hazrat Nizamuddin Auliya, New Delhi, Niazi Nizami Brothers present a beautiful Sufi kalam — “Aaj Rang Hai.”
This is not merely a Qawwali, but an expression of Ishq-e-Haqeeqi (Divine Love), spiritual devotion, and the timeless essence of Sufi tradition. Through our voice and rendition, we humbly present this beloved composition associated with the great Sufi poet Hazrat Amir Khusrau, keeping alive its profound spiritual legacy.
Kalam: Aaj Rang Hai
